desc:
WHIPPED FROSTING: A delicious artificially flavored butter cream frosting with a light, airy texture; Great for icing baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

A TRUSTED FAVORITE: Makes a perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

CONTAINS: One 12 oz tub of Betty Crocker Whipped Artificially Flavored Butter Cream Frosting
features:
Key Features:

Whipped & Fluffy Texture: Light and airy, making it easy to spread and perfect for decorating cakes, cupcakes, and cookies.

Classic Flavor: Available in buttery or vanilla flavor, offering a smooth, sweet taste that complements many desserts.

Gluten-Free: Suitable for individuals with gluten sensitivities.

Ready-to-Use: No preparation required—just open and use.

Shelf-Stable: Can be stored in the pantry before opening, making it convenient for occasional use.

Benefits:

Effortless Decorating: Great for quick dessert finishing touches—ideal for busy bakers or beginners.

Kid-Friendly: Easy for children to use with no special tools needed.

Versatile Application: Can be used as a filling, topping, or dip for fruits, crackers, or cookies.

Light Sweetness: Milder taste compared to richer frostings, appealing to those who prefer less sugary options.
ingredients: Sugar, Palm Oil, Water, Corn Syrup, Corn Starch. Contains 2% or less of: Monoglycerides, Cellulose Gel, Salt, Polysorbate 80, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Cellulose Gum, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Citric Acid, Color (yellows 5 & 6 and other color added). Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
